tag.description: Image tag override. Defaults to the chart's appVersion.

imagePullSecrets.description: Secrets for pulling images from private registries.

create.description: Create a dedicated ServiceAccount for the pod.

name.description: Use an existing ServiceAccount instead of creating one.

targetPort.description: Container port to forward to. Must match config.httpAddr.

config.description: Non-secret application configuration, rendered into a ConfigMap.

networkPassphrase.description: Override the network passphrase. Required when network is custom.

sorotrailUrl.description: SoroTrail indexer base URL. Required when sourceMode is sorotrail.

httpAddr.description: HTTP listen address (host:port). Must match service.targetPort.

httpMaxBodyBytes.description: Maximum API write-body size in bytes.

pollInterval.description: How often the poller calls getEvents (Go duration, minimum 1s).

monitorSilentAfter.description: How long since a monitor's last match before it is shown as silent.

readyzLagThreshold.description: Ledger lag at which /readyz fails. 0 disables the check.

networks.description: NETWORKS: comma-separated chains to poll, primary first. Empty means the single chain NETWORK names.

channelDisableAfterFailures.description: Consecutive permanent channel failures after which a channel is auto-disabled. 0 never auto-disables.

rateLimitRps.description: Per-client API requests per second. 0 disables the limiter.

rateLimitBurst.description: Per-client token-bucket size. 0 derives it from rateLimitRps.

rateLimitTrustForwarded.description: Key clients by X-Forwarded-For. Only behind a trusted proxy.

corsAllowedOrigins.description: Comma-separated browser origins allowed to call the API. Empty disables CORS.

alertRetention.description: How long to keep alerts, e.g. 90d or 24h. Empty keeps history forever.

configFile.description: Path to a config file read as a fallback for unset variables. Empty disables it; the chart mounts nothing.

horizonUrl.description: Horizon REST base URL. Required when sourceMode is horizon.

graphqlPlayground.description: Serve the interactive GraphQL playground. Off by default.

graphqlMaxDepth.description: GraphQL query depth ceiling (1-50). Empty uses the application default.

graphqlMaxComplexity.description: GraphQL query complexity ceiling (1-10000). Empty uses the application default.

rpcUrls.description: Comma-separated RPC endpoints to fail over between. Empty uses rpcUrl alone.

grpcAddr.description: gRPC listen address, e.g. :9090. Empty disables the gRPC server.

reorgTrackingWindow.description: Recent ledgers tracked for reorg detection. Empty uses the application default.

reorgConfirmationDepth.description: Ledgers of burial before a ledger is final. Empty uses the application default.

alertEnrichmentUrl.description: HTTP endpoint called to enrich an alert before delivery. Empty disables enrichment.

alertEnrichmentTimeout.description: Per-call timeout for enrichment (Go duration). Empty uses the application default.

alertEnrichmentCacheTtl.description: How long an enrichment response is cached. Empty uses the application default.

archiveUrl.description: Where pruned alerts are archived: a path, file://, dir:// or s3://. Empty disables archiving.

notifyRateLimitDefaultRps.description: Default per-channel delivery rate, requests per second. Empty uses the application default.

notifyRateLimitSlackRps.description: Slack delivery rate override. Empty uses the default.

notifyRateLimitTelegramRps.description: Telegram delivery rate override. Empty uses the default.

notifyRateLimitPagerdutyRps.description: PagerDuty delivery rate override. Empty uses the default.

otlpEndpoint.description: OpenTelemetry collector endpoint. Empty disables tracing.

otlpSampleRate.description: Trace sample rate, 0..1. Empty uses the application default.

database.description: External Postgres connection. Either url or existingSecret must be set.

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret holding the connection string.

existingSecretKey.description: Key within the existing Secret that holds the connection string.

url.description: Inline Postgres connection string. Ignored when existingSecret is set.

maxConns.description: pgx pool MaxConns. 0 uses the driver default.

minConns.description: pgx pool MinConns. 0 uses the driver default.

maxConnLifetime.description: pgx pool MaxConnLifetime (Go duration). Empty uses the driver default.

maxConnIdleTime.description: pgx pool MaxConnIdleTime (Go duration). Empty uses the driver default.

replicaUrl.description: Read-only replica connection string. Empty sends every read to the primary.

apiToken.description: API_TOKEN value(s), comma-separated. Empty leaves the API open.

workspaceTokens.description: WORKSPACE_TOKENS: comma-separated workspace=token bindings. A credential, rendered into the auth Secret.

configEncryptionKey.description: CONFIG_ENCRYPTION_KEY: base64 AES-GCM key for channel config at rest.

existingSecret.description: Name of an existing Secret holding the two credentials above.

apiTokenKey.description: Key within the existing Secret that holds API_TOKEN.

configEncryptionKeyKey.description: Key within the existing Secret that holds CONFIG_ENCRYPTION_KEY.

clientSecret.description: OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET. A credential, rendered into the auth Secret.

allowedDomains.description: OIDC_ALLOWED_DOMAINS: comma-separated e-mail domains allowed to sign in.

workspace.description: OIDC_WORKSPACE: the workspace an SSO user lands in.

workspaceClaim.description: OIDC_WORKSPACE_CLAIM: claim naming the user's workspace.

loginStateTTL.description: OIDC_LOGIN_STATE_TTL: how long a started login may take to return.

secrets.description: Where channel credentials are resolved from at delivery time.

provider.description: env (default) reads the encrypted database column; vault fetches from HashiCorp Vault.

cacheTtl.description: How long a resolved secret is cached. Empty uses the application default.

vaultAddr.description: Vault address. Only used when provider is vault.

vaultNamespace.description: Vault namespace. Only used when provider is vault.

vaultToken.description: VAULT_TOKEN. A credential, so it is stored in the auth Secret, never the ConfigMap.

enabled.description: Run migrations in a pre-install/pre-upgrade hook Job.

backoffLimit.description: Job retry budget before the release fails.

activeDeadlineSeconds.description: Upper bound on the hook, in seconds.
